SMTO-WEB-0017 — Web search isn't set up yet

GUID: 73a4e668-e542-4d75-9029-cac0f5a0e393
Slug: web-provider-not-configured
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web

What happened

  • SMTO tried to search the web, but no search service is turned on and chosen, so no search was sent. Reading a specific web address can still work.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings, expand Details and tools at the bottom, select Skills, then select Configure next to Web. This is where SMTO keeps the list of search services it can send searches to.
  2. Under Search providers, make sure at least one provider has Enabled turned on. DuckDuckGo works without any key or sign-up. A provider that is turned off is never used, even if it is listed.
  3. Set Default provider to that enabled provider, select Save, then select Test connection. SMTO sends searches only to the chosen default (or allowed fallbacks), and the test confirms it answers.
  4. Ask your question again in the conversation. The search was never sent, so repeating it after the setting is fixed is safe.

What success looks like

  • Test connection reports success and your next web search returns results.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't assume a provider is being used just because it is listed; it must be turned on and chosen as the default.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Web skill found no usable search provider: no enabled default provider is selected and the fallback policy allows no other provider, so the search was not sent.

What this means

  • Search or connection testing has no enabled selected provider after configuration lookup. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Search or connection testing has no enabled selected provider after configuration lookup.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the enabled provider list and default_provider_id.

How to fix it

  • Open Settings › Details and tools › Skills › Web › Configure. Add or enable a provider under Search providers (DuckDuckGo needs no key; SearXNG needs a running instance URL; Brave Search needs a Parameter Store key), select it as Default provider, Save, and use Test connection. Alternatively set Fallback search so an enabled provider or DuckDuckGo can be used.
  • Open Web skill configuration, configure a supported provider and choose its enabled default.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • One explicitly selected enabled provider receives the next authorized search.

What not to do

  • Do not assume that an installed provider is enabled or selected for search.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
